visualReview.notes: Every current standard frame inspected: long paired lancets, lower open arches, facade figures and tracery, gargoyles, pierced parapet and northwest pilgrim remain intact from all sides. The figure material correction retains the original geometry and avoids surface seams across sculpture.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Every current shared frame inspected, including the raised pilgrim, facade saints, animal symbols, crown and north-up placement. Reusable limestone supplies architectural coursing; carved figures retain their own smooth vertex-tinted fallback, preventing mortar patterns across bodies.

geographicReview.notes: The mapped tower body and wall axes agree with the north-up overlay. The raised Saint James is on the explicitly documented northwest corner, resolving the otherwise near-symmetric footprint. Gargoyles and parapets are legitimate small upper projections beyond the footprint.

fidelityReview.notes: Passed for the complete detailed polygonal exterior: city-published terrace height, nineteen facade saints, long Gothic lancet stages, corner strengthening, blind tracery, open crown and evangelist animals are represented. The sculptures are original geometric figures and motifs, with their documented count and architectural placement, rather than literal casts of the artworks.
